What Is Compliance Shield?

Compliance Shield is a continuous ADA/WCAG monitoring service for your website. We scan your site daily against WCAG 2.2 AA standards, alert you when new issues are found, and provide clear fix guidance so you can resolve problems before they become lawsuits.

How It Works

1

We Scan Daily

Our automated scanner checks your entire website against WCAG 2.2 AA standards every day.

2

We Alert You

When new issues are found, you get instant alerts via email and SMS with details on what needs fixing.

3

We Guide Fixes

Each issue comes with clear fix recommendations so you or your developer can resolve it quickly.

Daily WCAG 2.2 AA scans
